blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As language models (LMs) have improved, an increasingly common means of evaluating their linguistic competence is through explicit prompting (e.g., "Which sentence is more acceptable?"). Prior work indicates that such prompting underperforms compared to standard token-probability-based methods in smaller models, but improves in larger models. We test this in a new domain: semantic focus-sensitivity, responsible for contrasts like "Lucy only SWAM yesterday" vs. "Lucy only swam YESTERDAY". Testing models of various sizes using text-based focus markers like boldface and italics, we find universal above-chance performance for token probabilities. Prompting results mostly align with previous findings, but in some larger models they outperform probabilities by a wide margin. We propose that this is because LMs are not prone to produce out-of-the-blue focus marking, which muddies results from token probabilities in a way that does not affect prompting. We test this by replacing standard focus markers with randomly generated ones; token probabilities still beat chance but show significantly greater performance decrease compared to prompting. These results suggest that metalinguistic prompting, while non-trivial for LMs, can also be more robust when testing stylistically atypical data. We argue that this has important consequences for the assessment of LMs' language competence, even if LMs do not perform metalinguistic judgments through human-like introspection.
blocks.zh: 随着语言模型(LMs)的改进,评价其语言能力的一种越来越常见的方法就是通过明确的提示(如"哪个句子更能被接受?"). 先前的工作表明,在较小的模型中,与标准符号概率方法相比,这种诱发性表现不佳,但在较大的模型中则有所改善。 我们在一个新的领域测试:语义聚焦敏感,负责对比,如"Lucy only SWAM昨日"和"Lucy只游YSTERDAY". 使用粗体和斜体等基于文字的焦点标记来测试各种大小的模型,我们发现通用的上行性能以表示概率. 迅速的结果大多与以前的调查结果一致,但在某些较大的模型中,结果比概率大得多。 我们提议,这是因为LMs不易产生蓝外焦点标记,而泥土是象征性概率造成的,不会影响提示。 我们通过用随机生成的标准焦点标记来测试这一点;象征概率仍然比机会好,但显示与提示相比,性能显著地下降。 这些结果表明,金属活性催化在LMs的非三角作用下,在测试有型式的非典型数据时,也可更强。 我们争辩说,这对评估LMs的语言能力有重要影响,即使LMs不通过人性的内向分析来进行金属化判断。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The linguistic competence of language models (LMs) is often assessed by means of their output token probabilities: roughly, well-formed sentences are ceteris paribus expected to have higher token or string probabilities than ill-formed ones. While some prior work has used token probabilities to directly calculate acceptability scores on a per-sentence basis ( Clark et al. 2013 ; Lau et al. 2015 ), a more common technique is to compare the probabilities assigned to minimal pairs , near-identical pairs of sentences that differ in a single, targeted way, such as Mary is/*are sad (e.g., Linzen et al. 2016 ; Gulordava et al. 2018 ; Marvin and Linzen 2018 ; Futrell et al. 2019 ; Warstadt et al. 2020 ). Comparison of minimal pairs is common in theoretical and experimental research on human language (see e.g. Sprouse et al. 2013 ), and is useful in NLP research because it helps control for irrelevant factors that affect token or string probabilities, such as sentence length and the general frequency of individual tokens.
blocks.zh: 语言模型(LMs)的语言能力经常通过输出符号概率来评估: 大致来说,成形的句子是ceteris paribus,预期比不成形的句子或字符串概率更高. 虽然之前的一些作品使用象征性概率直接计算了按每个判决计算的可接受分数(Clark等人. 2013; Lau 等人 2015年),一种比较常见的手法是比较分配给最小对子的概率,近似对子的句子以单一,定向的方式不同,如玛丽是/*是悲伤的(例如Linzen等人 2016年;Gulordava等人 2018年;Marvin和Linzen 2018年;Futrell等人 2019年;Warstadt等人 2020年). 最小对子的比较在人类语言的理论和实验研究中很常见(例如参见Sprouse等人,2013年),在NLP研究中有用,因为它有助于控制影响符号或字符串概率的无关因素,如句子长度和个人符号的一般频率.

blocks.en: Thanks to major improvements in LM capabilities, an increasingly common alternative means of evaluating LMs’ linguistic competence is to simply present the relevant sentence(s) as part of a prompt to the model, along with a request for a judgment pertaining to well-formedness ( Dentella et al. 2023 ; Katzir 2023 ; Mahowald 2023 ; Murphy et al. 2025 ) or semantic/pragmatic truth or acceptability (e.g. Kamath et al. 2024 ; Tsvilodub et al. 2024 ). Such metalinguistic prompting is similar to judgment tasks commonly used in experimental research on humans, making it easy to construct studies comparing human and LM responses to more or less the same input.
blocks.zh: 由于LM能力的重大改进,评价LMs语言能力的一个越来越常见的替代手段是,简单地将相关句子作为提示的一部分提交给模型,同时要求就完善性作出判断(Dentella等人,2023年;Katzir 2023年;Mahowald 2023年;Murphy等人,2025年)或语义/语义的真伪或可接受性(例如Kamath等人,2024年;Tsvilodub等人,2024年)。 这种金属化的诱导类似于人类实验研究中常用的判断任务,使得研究很容易将人类和LM反应与大致相同的输入进行比较.

blocks.en: However, research directly comparing metalinguistic prompting to token probabilities shows very different performance between the two methods. Weaker LMs generally perform much worse when assessed by prompting than they do when assessed through string probabilities ( Hu and Levy 2023 ; Hu et al. 2024 ; Kauf et al. 2024 ), leading to significant underestimation of these models’ language competence. Hu and Frank (2024) observe that this gap in accuracy shrinks as models get larger and more capable; they attribute this to the auxiliary task demands of metalinguistic judgments, which stronger models are better able to cope with. Song et al. (2025) , meanwhile, find that with sufficiently large models, metalinguistic judgments can slightly but significantly outperform string probabilities.
blocks.zh: 然而,直接比较金属inguistic诱导与象征概率的研究表明两种方法之间的性能非常不同. 疲软的LMs在通过弦概率来评估时,一般表现比通过弦概率来评估时的提示要差得多(Hu和Levy 2023;Hu et al. Kauf等人,2024年),导致这些模型的语言能力严重低估。 胡和弗兰克(2024年)观察到,随着模型体积越来越大,能力更强,精度的这一差距会缩小;他们将此归因于金属化判断的辅助任务要求,更强大的模型更能应付. 宋等编. 同时(2025年)发现,有了足够大的模型,金属化的判断可以略微但明显地超过字符串概率.

blocks.en: In this paper we report two studies extending this foundational methodological research to a new empirical domain. Our results suggest a novel generalization about the accuracy of prompting versus string probabilities: while metalinguistic prompting is indeed only accessible to sufficiently large models, it can also be more robust than string probabilities when evaluating sentences that deviate from a model’s stylistically typical outputs.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们报告了两项研究,将这一基本方法研究扩大到一个新的经验领域。 我们的结果表明,对于激发和弦概率的准确性有了新的概括:虽然金属化的提示确实只能为足够大的模型所利用,但在评价偏离模型典型的典型输出的句子时,它也可以比弦概率更有力。

blocks.en:
Our empirical domain is semantic focus-sensitivity , a linguistic phenomenon in which the truth or pragmatic acceptability of a sentence depends on the placement of stress. By way of illustration, consider an adverb like only . If Mary gave one book to her teacher and one to her friend (and nothing to anyone else), then ( 1 ) is true and ( 1 ) false, despite differing only in focus placement ( Jackendoff 1972 ; Rooth 1985 ): {exe} \ex Mary only gave her teacher a BOOK. \ex Mary only gave her TEACHER a book.

As discussed in greater detail in Section 2 , semantic focus-sensitivity arises in a variety of environments in human language. Notably, in many cases the appropriateness of focus placement is dependent on context: ( 1 ) and ( 1 ) are both fine sentences in and of themselves, and it is only the context that makes ( 1 ) acceptable and ( 1 ) not.
blocks.zh:
我们的经验领域是语义上的焦点敏感性,一种语言现象,其中句子的真相或实际的可接受性取决于压力的放置. 作为例子,考虑一个副词 就像只。 如果玛丽给她的老师一本书,给朋友一本书(对任何人都没有),那么(1)是真实的,(1)是虚假的,尽管只在焦点位置上有所不同(Jackendoff 1972;Rooth 1985): {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}你觉得呢? 玛丽只给了她的老师一本书。 ưμ㼯A 玛丽只给了她一本书。

正如第2节更详细地讨论的那样,语义上的焦点敏感性出现在人类语言的各种环境中。 值得注意的是,在许多情况下,重点安排的适当性取决于上下文:(第1条)和(第1条)本身是罚款,只有上下文才能使(第1条)和(第1条)是可以接受的。

blocks.en: Our goals here are twofold. First, we wish to determine whether LMs have learned focus-sensitivity. And second, we compare and contrast string probabilities and prompting as methods of linguistically evaluating LMs. We test instruction-tuned models of various sizes from three model families—Gemma 4 ( Gemma Team 2026 ), Qwen3 ( Yang et al. 2025 ), and Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team 2026 )—on a manually created 282-item minimal pair dataset featuring various kinds of semantic focus-sensitivity, comparing the results using string probabilities to those using two types of prompts: forced choice , in which the LM is asked to choose which of the two sentences in a pair is more acceptable; and yes/no , in which the LM is presented with one sentence at a time and asked for a yes-or-no acceptability judgment. These methods are illustrated in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们的目标有两个。 首先,我们希望确定LMs是否学会了对重点的敏感性。 第二,我们比较和对比弦概率 并激励作为语言学评估LM的方法。 我们从三个模范家庭测试不同规模的教学模型—— Gemma 4 (Gemma Team 2026), Quen3 (Yang et al. 2025), Quen3.5 (Quen Team 2026) ——在一个以各种语义焦点敏感性为特点的手动创建了282项最小对数据集,用字符串概率将结果与使用两种刺激的概率进行比较:强迫选择,其中LM被要求选择两句中哪句更能被接受;是/否,其中LM一次被提出一句话,并要求作出"是-或-否"的可接受判断. 这些方法见表1。

blocks.en: Table 1: Illustration of string probability, forced choice, and yes/no evaluation methods.
blocks.zh: 表1:字符串概率图示,强制选择,是/否评价方法.

blocks.en: In Experiment 1, discussed in Section 3 , we test how models perform using eight relatively standard methods for text-based focus-marking: all caps; HTML and Markdown boldface, italics, and emphasis; and HTML underlining. We find that for all models, string probabilities perform significantly above chance, suggesting substantial LM acquisition of semantic focus-sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 在第3节讨论的实验1中,我们测试模型如何使用八种相对标准的方法进行基于文本的焦点标记:所有盖;HTML和Markdown粗体、斜体和强调;以及HTML下划线。 我们发现,对于所有模型来说,弦概率的性能大大高于偶然性,说明大量LM获得语义聚焦敏感性.

blocks.en: Regarding the methodological comparison, in certain respects the results accord nicely with prior work: prompting methods perform poorly for small models and gradually improve as models get bigger, with forced choice outperforming yes/no prompting (cf. Panickssery et al. 2024 ). However, in the case of the larger Gemma 4 models forced choice prompting not only beats string probabilities, but does so by a wide margin. We hypothesize that this is because the models are not prone to produce out-of-the-blue focus marking, which lowers the general probability of unsolicited focus marking and muddies string probability results. But for models that are strong enough to perform forced choice, such stylistic unnaturalness is less of a hindrance, since ( i ) the focus marking is in the input, rather than the output; and ( ii ) the side-by-side comparison of paired sentences clarifies the criteria of evaluation, hence why forced choice also outperforms yes/no prompting.
blocks.zh: 关于方法比较,在某些方面,结果与以前的工作很吻合:在小型模型中,激励方法表现不佳,随着模型的扩大而逐步改进,强迫选择表现优于 " 是 " / " 不 " 激励 " (参见Panickssery等人,2024年)。 然而,对于更大的Gemma 4型号,强制选择不仅激发了字符串概率,而且还以很大幅度的空间来达到. 我们假设这是因为模型不易产生蓝外聚焦标记,这降低了非主动聚焦标记的一般概率和泥巴串概率结果. 但是对于足够强力来进行强制选择的模型来说,这种风格的不自然性并不是什么障碍,因为(一)焦点标记是在输入中,而不是输出中;和(二)对配对句子的并排比较澄清了评价的标准,因此为什么强制选择也比"是"/"不"促进"的成绩还要好.

blocks.en: To test this, in Experiment 2 (Section 4 ) we replace standard focus markers with randomly generated focus bracketing (e.g., Mary only gave her teacher a $:#book#:$ ), on the assumption that these deviate even further from the models’ expected outputs. While we unsurprisingly find general accuracy decreases, string probabilities continue to beat chance for all models, suggesting that what the models have learned is more general and not confined to a closed class of canonical text-based focus markers. However, string probabilities also show a proportionally greater decline in accuracy than forced choice prompting, with the number of instances of forced choice significantly outperforming string probabilities more than doubling. This supports the hypothesis that while forced choice prompting is more difficult for a model to acquire, it can also be more robust than string probabilities when evaluating sentences that deviate from a model’s stylistic inclinations.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这一点,在实验2(第4节)中,我们用随机生成的焦点括号替换标准焦点标记(例如,Mary只给了她的老师$:#book#:$),假设这些标记更偏离模型的预期产出。 虽然我们毫不奇怪地发现一般的精度下降,但字符串概率继续战胜所有模型的机会,说明模型学到的更多是一般的,并不局限于闭合类的基于犬文的焦点标记. 然而,字符串概率也显示精确度的下降比例大于强制选择提示,强制选择的实例数量大大超过性能的字符串概率超过一倍. 这支持这样的假设,即虽然强制选择促使一个模型获得的难度更大,但在评价偏离模型结构倾向的句子时,它也可以比弦概率更强.

blocks.en: In Section 5 we discuss the consequences of these results for the linguistic assessment of LMs. This is especially pertinent because recent work suggests that the language knowledge LMs use to make metalinguistic judgments may be distinct from the implicit knowledge they use to generate outputs, inviting questions about which is the true measure of an LM’s linguistic competence, regardless of comparative accuracy ( Song et al. 2025 ). However, we argue that even if we accept these results at face value, there needn’t be one “true” indicator of an LM’s language abilities: it is equally plausible that these methods test distinct but coequal facets of the core language modeling task, loosely analogous to the contrast between production (string probabilities) and comprehension (prompting). From this perspective, prompting and probabilities complement each other, and studying both promises to give a more holistic picture of LM competence than can be achieved through one methodology alone.
blocks.zh: 在第5节中,我们讨论了这些结果对LMs语言评估的影响。 这一点特别相关,因为最近的工作表明,语言知识LMs用来作出金属化判断可能不同于它们用来产生产出的隐含知识,因此,不管比较准确与否,这都会引起一个LM语言能力的真正衡量标准的问题(Song等人,2025年)。 然而,我们争辩说,即使我们以面值接受这些结果,LM语言能力也不必有一个“真实的”指标:同样合理的是,这些方法检验核心语言建模任务的不同但均匀的方面,与生产(弦概率)和理解(概率)之间的对比大致相似。 从这一角度出发,激励和概率相辅相成,并研究这两个方面都希望更全面地反映LM能力,而不是仅通过一种方法就能实现的。

blocks.en: 2 Focus-sensitive environments
blocks.zh: 2. 注重重点的环境

blocks.en: As was mentioned in the introduction, focus-sensitivity is common across a wide range of environments. We have already seen one example: association with only , as exemplified by the contrast between ( 1 ) and ( 1 ). Another example is question-answer congruence , which ties the use of focus in an answer to its semantic relationship with the question ( von Stechow 1991 ; Rooth 1992 ). Thus, in response to Who did Phil give a book to? , ( 2 ) is fine, while ( 2 ) is odd: {exe} \ex Phil gave a book to the SENATOR. \ex Phil gave a BOOK to the senator.
blocks.zh: 如导言所述,对重点的敏感性在广泛的环境中是常见的。 我们已经看到一个例子:仅与......有关联,例如(......)和(......)之间的对比。 另一个例子是问答一致,将焦点的使用与问题的语义关系联系起来(von Stechow 1991;Rooth 1992)。 因此,在回答菲尔给谁的书?,(2)是罚款,而(2)是奇数:{exe}\x 菲尔给SENATOR一本书。 ưμ㼯A 菲尔给了参议员一本书

blocks.en: Yet another example is the focus-sensitivity of additive too : as a continuation of The doctor greeted the nurse , ( 2 ) is acceptable, while ( 2 ) is not ( Kadmon 2001 ; Kripke 2009 ): {exe} \ex and the PATIENT greeted the nurse, too. \ex and the patient greeted the NURSE, too.
blocks.zh: 另一个例子是添加剂的焦点敏感性:作为医生问候护士的延续(2)是可以接受的,而(2)则不是(Kadmon 2001;Kripke 2009):{exe}\ex和PATIENT也问候了护士。 \ex和病人问候NURSE。

blocks.en: A fourth example of focus-sensitivity can be seen in what Lewis (1975) calls adverbs of quantification , such as always and usually ( Rooth 1985 , Partee 1991 , Krifka 1992 , von Fintel 1994 ). If Sarah rarely runs, but when she does she opts for a morning run, then ( 2 ) is true, while ( 2 ) is not: {exe} \ex Sarah usually runs in the MORNING. \ex Sarah usually RUNS in the morning.
blocks.zh: 从刘易斯(1975年)所称的量化副词中可以看出第4个关注敏感度的例子,例如总是和通常的(Rooth 1985年、Partee 1991年、Krifka 1992年、von Fintel 1994年)。 如果莎拉很少跑,但当她选择晨跑时,那么(2)是真实的,而(2)不是:{exe}\ex莎拉通常在早晨跑. - Sarah通常早上会去

blocks.en:
Finally there is contrastive focus, such as so-called contrastive negation : if someone claims that Sarah bought a green shirt when she actually bought a red one, then ( 2 ) is a good response, while ( 2 ) is not ( Jackendoff 1972 ): {exe} \ex Sarah didn’t buy the GREEN shirt. \ex Sarah didn’t buy the green SHIRT.

Contrastive focus often comes in pairs. Thus, ( 2 ) is better followed by ( 2 ) than ( 2 ): {exe} \ex …she bought a RED shirt. \ex …she bought a red SHIRT.
blocks.zh:
最后,还有反面重点,如所谓的反面否定: 如果有人声称Sarah买了一件绿色衬衫 而她真的买了一件红色衬衫 那么(2)是一个好的反应 而(2)不是(Jackendoff 1972):{exe}\ex 莎拉没有买绿色衬衫。 ưμ㼯A Sarah没有买绿色SHIRT。

对立的焦点往往成对出现. 因此, (2) 后面是 (2) 比 (2) : {exe}\ex... 她买了一件RED 衬衫。 她买了红色的SHIRT

blocks.en: These do not constitute the full range of focus-sensitive environments (see Kadmon 2001 ; Beaver and Clark 2008 for more). However, we consider the environments discussed above to be both diverse and commonplace enough to constitute a reasonable test domain for LM competence. With this in mind, we now turn to our experiments.
blocks.zh: 这些并不是全方位的注重重点的环境(更多见Kadmon 2001;Beaver和Clark 2008)。 然而,我们认为,上文讨论的环境既多样又常见,足以构成对LM能力的合理测试领域。 考虑到这一点,我们现在转向我们的实验。

blocks.en: 3 Experiment 1: Standard focus markers
blocks.zh: 3 实验 1: 标准重点标记

blocks.en: 3.1 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3.1 方法

blocks.en: We tested LMs’ semantic focus-sensitivity using a manually created dataset consisting of 282 minimal pairs, representing each kind of focus-sensitivity discussed above: association with only ( only , 52 items), question-answer congruence ( qa , 50 items), association with too ( too , 50 items), adverbs of quantification ( adv_qt , 40 items), contrastive negation ( contr1 , 40 items), and contrastive focus following negation as in ( 2 ) ( contr2 , 50 items). In order to be able to test a variety of different text-based focus markers, the dataset was created as a “seed” with focus indicated by bracketing; bracketed material could then be replaced with any of a variety of focus markers.
blocks.zh: 我们利用由282个最低对数组成的手工数据集测试了LMs的语义重点敏感性,代表了上文讨论过的每一种重点敏感性:仅与(仅)52个项目相关联,回答一致(qa,50个项目),也与(太,50个项目)相关联,量化副词(adv_qt,40个项目),对比否定(contr1,40个项目),以及否定(2)(contr2,50个项目)之后的对比焦点。 为了能够测试各种不同的基于文字的焦点标记,数据集是作为一个“种子”创建的,其焦点通过括号表示;然后可以将括号内的材料替换为各种焦点标记。

blocks.en: Every item came with either a background , i.e., information that is required to assess the acceptability of a sentence in the minimal pair; or a prefix , the beginning of a statement for which the minimal pair sentences would serve as continuations. only and adv_qt items came with informational backgrounds that entailed the good sentence, but not the bad sentence. 2 2 2 More specifically, for these items the backgrounds were neutral with respect to the truth of the bad sentence. For some models we also tried an alternate version of the dataset where the background explicitly contradicted the bad sentence; this led to worse results, which we attribute to the additional complexity required of the backgrounds. qa items’ backgrounds were simply the question to be answered, while contr1 items had backgrounds that made only the good sentence pragmatically felicitous. too and contr2 items had prefixes. Importantly, none of the backgrounds or prefixes had any focus marking themselves, so in all items focus marking was “out-of-the-blue”. Examples of the six categories of item can be seen in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 每件物品都附有一个背景,即评估最低配对中某一句的可接受性所需的信息;或者有一个前缀,即最低配对句作为延续的语句开头. 只有和 adv_ qt 项来的信息背景 包含好句子, 而不是坏句子。 2个 2 更具体地说,就这些项目而言,对于错误句子的真相,背景是中立的。 对于一些模型,我们还尝试了数据集的替代版本,其中背景明显与错误的句子相矛盾;这导致了更糟糕的结果,我们将此归因于对背景要求的额外复杂性. qa项目的背景只是需要回答的问题,而contr1项目的背景却只能使好句子务实地令人欣慰。 Contr2项目也有前缀。 重要的是,没有任何背景或前缀本身有重点标识,因此在所有项目中,重点标识都是“蓝外”。 这六类项目的例子见表2。

blocks.en: For Experiment 1, we tested eight anecdotally common ways of textually marking focus: all caps (standard in theoretical linguistics); HTML underlining; and HTML and Markdown boldface, italicized, and emphasized fonts. Thus, the full dataset consisted of 8 × \times 282 = = 2,256 pairs.
blocks.zh: 对于实验1,我们测试了八种常见的文字标记焦点方法:所有盖(理论语言学的标准);HTML下划线;以及HTML和Markdown粗体,斜体化,强调字体. 因此,完整的数据集由8×282=2,256对数据组成.

blocks.en: We tested seventeen instruction-tuned models from three model families: Gemma 4 ( Gemma Team 2026 ), Qwen3 ( Yang et al. 2025 ), and Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team 2026 ). These model families were selected because each has a relatively wide range of model sizes. The tested models ranged in size from 600 million to 35 billion parameters. The Gemma 4 models tested were E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B, and 31B; the Qwen3 models were 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B, and 32B; and the Qwen3.5 models were 0.8B, 2B, 4B, 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B. Notably, for Gemma 4 and Qwen3.5, some of the models are architecturally distinct enough from their peers to preclude a true apples-to-apples size comparison, whether that be due to a mixture-of-experts architecture (Gemma 4 26B-A4B, Qwen3.5 35B-A3B) or per-layer embeddings (Gemma 4 E2B, E4B). Thus, discussion of the impact of model size will be framed exclusively in descriptive terms.
blocks.zh: 我们测试了来自三个模范家庭的17个教学模式: Gemma 4 (Gemma Team 2026), Quen3 (Yang et al. 2025), Quen3.5 (Quen Team 2026). 这些模范家庭之所以被选中,是因为每个家庭的模范规模范围相对较广. 试验模型的规模从6亿到350亿参数不等。 测试的Gemma 4型机车为E2B型,E4B型,12B型,26B-A4B型,31B型;Qune3型机车为0.6B型,1.7B型,4B型,8B型,14B型,32B型;Qune3.5型机车为0.8B型,2B型,4B型,9B型,27B型,35B-A3B型. 值得注意的是,对Gemma 4和Quen3.5来说,有些模型在建筑上与同龄人具有足够的区别,无法进行真正的苹果对苹果大小的比较,无论是由于专家混合结构(Gemma 4 26B-A4B,Quen3.5 35B-A3B)还是每层嵌入(Gemma 4 E2B,E4B). 因此,关于模型规模的影响的讨论将仅以描述性方式进行。

blocks.en: Each model was tested on the full dataset using three evaluation methods: string probabilities ( SP ), forced choice ( FC ), and yes/no ( YN ). Each method involved evaluating the models based on various output token probabilities, whether they be for the sentences themselves (SP) or for potential metalinguistic judgments (FC/YN); these token probabilities were obtained using the minicons package ( Misra 2022 ).
blocks.zh: 每个模型都使用三种评价方法在全数据集上进行了测试:字符串概率(SP),强制选择(FC),是/否(YN). 每种方法都涉及根据各种输出符号概率评估模型,无论是用于句子本身(SP)还是用于潜在的金属inguistic判断(FC/YN);这些符号概率是通过迷你孔包(Misra 2022)获得的.

blocks.en: For the first method, whether a model got a minimal pair correct was determined by whether it assigned a higher log probability to the good sentence than to the bad sentence in a specific context C C : log ⁡ P ⁡ ( s good | C ) > log ⁡ P ⁡ ( s bad | C ) \log{P}(s_{\text{good}}\ |\ {C})>\log{P}(s_{\text{bad}}\ |\ {C})
blocks.zh: 对于第一种方法,一个模型是否获得最小对数的正确性,取决于它是否在特定上下文CC中给好句子分配了比坏句子更高的日志概率: log QQ P QQ(s good QC) > log QQ (s bad C)\log{P}(s_{\text{good}}\}{C})\log{P}(s_{\text{bad}}\) |\{C}

blocks.en: The context for a given item was determined as follows. All message histories started with a system message of “You are a helpful assistant.” If there was a background, it was encoded as a user message; if not, the user message was empty. If there was a prefix, then this was encoded as the beginning of an assistant message that the LM was to continue. For only and adv_qt items, in addition to providing the background as a user message, the context included “Therefore, ” as an assistant message prefix; this was done to encourage LM outputs that served as deductions based on the information in the background.
blocks.zh: 某一项目的背景确定如下。 所有信息历史都以“你是一个有帮助的助手”的系统信息开头。 如果有背景,则编码为用户消息;如果没有,则用户消息是空的. 如果有一个前缀,那么这被编码为一个助理消息的开头,即LM要继续. 仅针对和adv_qt项目,除了提供背景作为用户消息外,上下文还包括"因此,"作为助理消息前缀;这样做是为了鼓励LM输出作为根据背景信息进行扣减.

blocks.en: The first prompting method we tested was a forced choice paradigm. The system prompt (“You are a helpful assistant.”) was followed by a user message with a brief introduction to the task, the relevant background or prefix, and both the good and bad follow-up sentences (Sentences A and B). The model was then tasked with responding with “A” or “B”, based on which sentence was preferred. Two prompts were tested (FC1/FC2), with slight variations in both how the instructions were presented and whether the tested LM response was simply “A”/“B” or included an assistant message prefix of “My answer is ”.
blocks.zh: 我们测试的第一种激励方法是强制选择模式。 系统提示(“You is a helpful assistance.”)之后是用户信息,简要介绍任务,相关背景或前缀,以及好坏两个后续句子(Sentences A和B). 然后,该模式的任务是以“A”或“B”作为答复,并以此为主句。 测试了两个提示(FC1/FC2),在说明如何提出以及测试的LM响应是否只是“A”/“B”或包括“我的回答是......”的助理信息前缀方面略有不同。

blocks.en:
To control for a potential ordering bias ( Pezeshkpour and Hruschka 2024 ), each item was run twice: once with the good sentence as Sentence A, and once as Sentence B. A model was considered to have gotten a given item correct if the summed log probabilities of the correct answers exceeded the summed log probabilities of the incorrect answers: log ⁡ P ⁡ ( “A” | C A ) + log ⁡ P ⁡ ( “B” | C B ) > log ⁡ P ⁡ ( “A” | C B ) + log ⁡ P ⁡ ( “B” | C A ) \log{P}(\text{``A''}\ |\ C_{\text{A}})+\log{P}(\text{``B''}\ |\ C_{\text{B}})>{}\\
\log{P}(\text{``A''}\ |\ C_{\text{B}})+\log{P}(\text{``B''}\ |\ C_{\text{A}})
blocks.zh:
为了控制潜在的订单偏差(Pezeshkpour和Hruschka 2024),每个项目运行了两次:一次是好句子作为A,一次是B. 如果正确答案的集合日志概率超过不正确答案的集合日志概率,则一个模型被认为得到了一个给定项目正确性:log + P + P + (“A” + C A ) + log + P → P → (“B” + C B ) + log → P → (“A” + C + C + A )\log { P } (\ text + + C + text{ A + ) + P → (\ text + B +)
\log{P}(\text\A'}\\\ text{B}\ log{P}(\text\B'}\ text\B'}\\ text{A})

blocks.en: The other metalinguistic prompting method we used was a simple yes-or-no prompt, where the model was presented with one sentence at a time along with the background/prefix, and was asked to answer “Yes” or “No” depending on if the sentence was acceptable. We again tested this paradigm with two prompts (YN1/YN2), which varied similarly to FC’s.
blocks.zh: 我们使用的另一种金属化的促动方法是一种简单的“是”或“否”的促动方法,在“是”或“否”的促动方法中,该模型与背景/前缀一起,被要求回答“是”或“否”,取决于该句是否可以接受。 我们再次用两个提示(YN1/YN2)测试了这个模式,这些提示与FC类似。

blocks.en:
To decide the accuracy for a given item, we adopted a similar method as for FC: a model got an item correct if the summed log probabilities of accurate answers exceeded the summed log probabilities of inaccurate answers: log ⁡ P ⁡ ( “Yes” | C good ) + log ⁡ P ⁡ ( “No” | C bad ) > log ⁡ P ⁡ ( “Yes” | C bad ) + log ⁡ P ⁡ ( “No” | C good ) \log{P}(\text{``Yes''}\ |\ C_{\text{good}})+\log{P}(\text{``No''}\ |\ C_{\text{bad}})>{}\\
\log{P}(\text{``Yes''}\ |\ C_{\text{bad}})+\log{P}(\text{``No''}\ |\ C_{\text{good}})
blocks.zh:
为了确定某一项的准确性,我们采用了与FC相似的方法:如果准确答案的汇总日志概率超过不准确答案的汇总日志概率,则一个模型得到了正确的项目:log + P + P + (“是” + C 好) + log + P + (“否” + C 差) > log + P + (“是” + C坏 ) + log + P + (“ 否” + C好 )\ log {P } (\ text + yes' + + C + text + Good + )\ log {P } (\ text + \ no' + + C + text { bad + )}

blocks.en: The items in the dataset are designed so that the good and bad sentences are both acceptable in and of themselves, and it is only the background or prefix that determines which sentence is the better one. But there is a potential for bias in the dataset. Note that for a sentence like Mary greeted the vicar , backgrounds could be devised that make the focusing of either the or vicar felicitous; however, the latter is more natural out of the blue. Thus, if a background is provided that encourages the focusing of vicar , and a model gets that right, then there is a risk that the model is relying on a simpler syntactic heuristic dictating that nouns like vicar are more likely to be focused than determiners like the , rather than using the background information as desired (cf. Gururangan et al. 2018 for similar observations on NLI datasets). To test for such bias, a control version of each item was run with the background/prefix removed, for all models and evaluation methods. Whether or not there was a bias in the dataset could then be inferred based on whether models’ performance significantly deviated from chance.
blocks.zh: 数据集中的项目设计使得好句子和坏句子本身都是可以接受的,只有背景或前缀决定哪个句子是更好的句子. 但数据集中存在偏差的可能性. 请注意,对于像Mary问候牧师这样的句子,可以设计出使牧师或牧师的注意力集中的背景;然而,后者则更自然。 因此,如果提供了鼓励教士关注的背景,而一个模型得到正确评价,那么,该模型就有可能依赖于一种更简单的综合heuristic的描述,即像教士这样的名词比像教士那样的确定者更有可能被关注,而不是像希望的那样使用背景资料(关于NLI数据集的类似观察,参见Gurururangan等人,2018年)。 为了测试这种偏差,对所有模型和评价方法,对每个项目都进行了控制版本,并删除了背景/前缀。 然后可以根据模型的性能是否明显偏离机会来推断数据集是否存在偏差。

blocks.en: 3.2 Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果

blocks.en: Figure 1: Results of Experiment 1 (standard focus markers). Error bars are bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals. X-axes are logarithmically spaced.
blocks.zh: 图1:实验1的结果(标准重点标记). 误差栏为95%的置信间隔 。 X轴为对数间距.

blocks.en: The results of Experiment 1 can be seen in Figure 1 . Starting with the control items, larger models tended to perform slightly but significantly above chance, suggesting that there is in fact a non-trivial degree of bias in the dataset. Nonetheless, the results for the target items outpace the controls by a wide enough margin that we can safely conclude that positive target results are not attributable to mere bias, and the LMs’ success is significantly dependent on the backgrounds and prefixes.
blocks.zh: 实验1的结果可参见图1. 从控制项目开始,较大的模型的性能往往略微但明显高于机会,这表明数据集实际上存在某种程度的非三角偏差. 然而,目标项目的结果比控制的速度要快得多,我们可以安全地得出结论,积极的目标结果不能仅仅归因于偏见,而LMs的成功在很大程度上取决于背景和前缀。

blocks.en: Moving on to the target items, many of the results for focus look similar to observations from prior work. To test for differences between methods, we fitted a mixed-effect logistic regression for each LM, predicting accuracy with a fixed effect of method (baseline = SP) and random effects for focus marker and item; statistical tests were performed using the lme4 R package ( Bates et al. 2015 ). SP performed above chance for all models ( p < .001 p<.001 across the board). For the smaller models, SP also significantly outperformed the prompting-based methods, in line with previous observations ( Hu and Levy 2023 ; Hu et al. 2024 ; Kauf et al. 2024 ). FC and YN generally improved as models got bigger, which fits neatly with prior results from Hu and Frank (2024) .
blocks.zh: 谈到目标项目,许多重点成果看起来与以往工作的结果类似。 为了检验各种方法之间的差异,我们为每种LM安装了混合效应后勤回归,预测了方法的固定效果(基线=SP)和焦点标记和物品的随机效果;使用lme4 R包进行了统计测试(Bates等人,2015年)。 SP对所有型号的成绩都高于机会(第 < 001页,第 < 001页)。 对于较小的型号,SP的性能也大大高于以提示为基础的方法,与之前的观测(Hu和Levy 2023;Hu et al. 2024 ; Kauf 等人 2024 .). FC和YN一般随着模型的变大而得到改善,这与胡和弗兰克的先前结果(2024 年)完全吻合.

blocks.en: Among prompting methods, FC generally outperformed YN, especially in larger models. This is unsurprising, since FC has the advantage of directly comparing the paired sentences, though we also cannot rule out the possibility that YN could improve with prompt engineering. FC outperforming YN also fits well with prior work on LMs (e.g., Panickssery et al. 2024 ), as well as with research on humans, where forced choice results appear to be more powerful than single-item evaluations for both linguistic acceptability judgments ( Sprouse et al. 2013 ) and tasks in other cognitive domains ( Gigerenzer and Richter 1990 ).
blocks.zh: 在催化方法中,FC一般优于YN,特别是在更大的模型中. 这不足为奇,因为FC的优点是直接比较配对的句子,虽然我们也不能排除YN用即时工程改进的可能性. FC优于YN也与以往关于LMs(如Panickssery等人,2024年)的工作以及对人类的研究相适应,在语言可接受性判断(Sprouse等人,2013年)和其他认知领域的任务(Gigerenzer和Richter,1990年)中,强制选择结果似乎比单项评价更有力。

blocks.en: However, a notable wrinkle in our results comes from those cases where prompting significantly outperformed string probabilities. This was observed for Qwen3.5 27B, where FC1 outperformed SP ( p < .001 p<.001 ), but the gap was much wider for Gemma 4 12B FC2, 26B-A4B FC2, and 31B FC1 and FC2 (all p < .001 p<.001 ), each of which outperformed their respective SP scores by a considerable margin. In fact, among all model-method pairs, each of the top three performers used FC: Gemma 4 31B FC2 (95.3%) and FC1 (91.7%), and Qwen3.5 27B FC1 (91.3%).
blocks.zh: 然而,我们的结果中有一个显著的皱纹来自那些导致业绩明显超过弦概率的情况。 在Qwen3.5 27B中观察到这一点,FC1的性能超过了SP(p < 001 p < 001),但Gemma 4 12B FC2,26B-A4B FC2,31B FC1和FC2(均p < 001 p < 001)的性能差距要大得多,它们各自的SP分数都以相当的比分超过. 事实上,在所有的模型-方法配对中,前三名的表演者都使用FC:Gemma 4 31B FC2(95.3%)和FC1(91.7%),以及Quen3.5 27B FC1(91.3%).

blocks.en: Note also that the two mixture-of-experts models, Gemma 4 26B-A4B and Qwen3.5 35B-A3B, saw a dip in performance compared to smaller non-MoE models in the same family. This suggests that MoE’s reduction in active parameters has a negative impact on performance that is especially felt by prompting-based methods.
blocks.zh: 还注意到,Gemma 4 26B-A4B和Quen3.5 35B-A3B这两个专家混合模型,与同一家族中较小的非MOE模型相比,性能出现了下降. 这表明,教育部减少活动参数对表现有负面影响,而这种影响尤其通过以激励为基础的方法来感受到。

blocks.en: Figure 2 zooms in on the best-performing model in each model family, showing SP and FC accuracy for each focus-sensitive environment. On a descriptive level, only items mostly saw high accuracy across models and methods, while too items showed lower accuracy. However, no definitive conclusions can be drawn from such observations, since manually created data could contain biases that make some items more difficult for independent reasons ( Ettinger et al. 2018 ). More importantly for our purposes, note that Gemma 4 31B FC1 and FC2 outperformed SP across all categories, suggesting that the advantage of FC was general and not confined to a subclass of environments. The picture is more mixed for Qwen3.5 27B FC1 (which also beat SP), partly due to SP’s near-ceiling performance in multiple categories.
blocks.zh: 图2放大了每个模型家族中表现最好的模型,显示了每个焦点敏感环境的SP和FC精度. 在描述性方面,只有大多数项目在模型和方法上表现的精度很高,而项目也显示的精度较低。 然而,无法从这些观察中得出明确的结论,因为人工生成的数据可能含有偏差,使一些项目因独立原因而更加困难(Ettinger等人,2018年)。 更重要的是,就我们的目的而言,请注意,Gemma 4 31B FC1和FC2在所有类别中都超过了SP,这表明FC的优势是普遍的,并不限于一个亚类的环境. 图片对Qwen3.5 27B FC1(也击败了SP)来说比较混杂,部分原因是SP在多个类别中的近顶级性能.

blocks.en: Figure 2: SP/FC accuracy by type of focus-sensitivity for the top-performing model in each family. Error bars are bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 图2:各家族中顶级模型按重点敏感性类型分列的SP/FC精度。 误差栏为95%的置信间隔 。

blocks.en: As was discussed above, the fact that SP outperforms prompting in smaller models is relatively unsurprising in light of previous work: SP is a direct reflection of the language modeling task, whereas metalinguistic judgments are a more demanding task that smaller models will tend to struggle with ( Hu and Frank 2024 ). The puzzle, then, is how FC can come to significantly outperform SP, especially by the wide margins seen for Gemma 4. The answer, we propose, is that once FC is acquired, it is better equipped than SP to evaluate sentences that diverge substantially from normal model outputs. Recall that in the dataset focus marking is always out of the blue, as it is absent from the backgrounds and prefixes. It seems at least plausible that a result of the models’ training would be a disinclination to produce, say, HTML … tags without solicitation. This could in turn muddy the waters when it comes to comparing the string probabilities of sentences that do contain such out-of-the-blue tags, which would exert downward pressure on SP accuracy.
blocks.zh: 正如上文所讨论的那样,从以往的工作来看,SP在较小的模型中表现优于PP的情况相对来说并不奇怪: SP直接反映了语言建模任务,而金属语的判断是一项更艰巨的任务,较小的模型往往会与之纠缠(Hu和Frank 2024 ). 因此,谜题是FC如何大大超过SP,特别是Gemma 4的宽边。 我们建议,答案是,一旦获得FC,它比SP更能评价与正常模型输出大不相同的句子。 回顾在数据集中焦点标记总是出乎意料的,因为它从背景和前缀中都不存在. 似乎至少可以认为,这些模型的培训结果是不情愿不引人注意地制作HTML <b>.<b>标签。 在比较确实含有这种蓝外标记的句子的弦概率时,这又可能使水水泥化,这将对SP的准确性造成下压。

blocks.en: FC, meanwhile, has two advantages over SP in this regard. First, the evaluated sentences (and their focus marking) are part of the input rather than the output, rendering irrelevant the low likelihood that the model would produce them as outputs. And second, FC is unlike SP and YN in that the model is presented with both sentences simultaneously, which introduces additional clarity in terms of both the criteria of evaluation and the bounds of comparison. The poor performance of YN—which enjoys the first advantage but not the second—suggests that the latter may be more impactful, though YN’s poor performance could well be chalked up to independent factors.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,促进委员会在这方面比战略计划有两个优势。 首先,被评价的句子(及其焦点标记)是投入而不是产出的一部分,这使得模型作为产出产生这些句子的低可能性变得无关紧要. 其次,FC不同于SP和YN,因为模型同时呈现两种句子,这在评价标准和比较范围两方面都引入了额外的清晰度. YN的不良表现——它享有第一优势,但并非第二优势——建议后者可能更具影响力,尽管YN的不良表现完全可以归结为独立因素。

blocks.en: The proposed picture, then, is as follows. First, the increased task demands of metalinguistic judgments entail that the success of prompting methods will be particularly dependent on model size. Hence, performance is poor for small models and improves for larger models. Second, when comparing between prompting methods, FC has a significant advantage over YN, since for FC the model sees both sentences simultaneously, while for YN the model must make each decision in isolation. And third, for those models that achieve strong prompting-based performance, FC has an advantage over SP when evaluating sentences that diverge substantially from normal model outputs.
blocks.zh: 因此,拟议情况如下。 首先,对冶金学判断的任务要求增加,这就要求促进方法的成功尤其取决于模型大小。 因此,小型模型的性能不佳,大型模型的性能也有所改善。 第二,FC在对催化方法进行比较时,比YN有显著优势,因为对于FC来说,模型同时看到两个句子,而对于YN来说,模型必须孤立地作出每个决定. 第三,对于那些实现强烈的促动性能的模型,在评价与正常模型输出大相径庭的句子时,FC比SP有优势.

blocks.en: This proposal makes a noteworthy prediction: if we modify our items so that they diverge even further from normal model outputs, then any concomitant negative impact on accuracy should more strongly affect SP than FC. In other words, once FC judgments are successfully learned, they should be more robust to stylistic atypicality than SP. We test this prediction next.
blocks.zh: 这项建议提出了值得注意的预测:如果我们修改我们的项目,使其与正常的模型输出更加不同,那么对准确性的任何随之而来的不利影响应比促进中心更强烈地影响SP。 换句话说,一旦成功地学习了FC的判断,它们就应该比SP更强健地达到风格上的非典型性. 我们接下来测试这个预测

blocks.en: 4 Experiment 2: Ad hoc focus markers
blocks.zh: 4 实验 2: 特别重点标记

blocks.en: In Experiment 2, we replace common focus markers like boldface and italics with randomly-generated ad hoc focus markers. This serves two purposes. The first is to determine whether the models’ knowledge of focus is specific to a closed class of canonical focus markers, or whether they have learned something more general. The second is to determine whether these more artificial focus markers lead to a greater decrease in accuracy for SP than for FC, as is predicted by our proposal.
blocks.zh: 在"实验2"中,我们用随机生成的特设焦点标记来取代像粗体和斜体这样的常见焦点标记. 这有两个目的。 首先是确定模型对焦点的知识是针对闭锁类的犬科焦点标记,还是已经学到了更一般的东西. 第二是确定这些更人为的焦点标记是否导致SP比FC更精确的降低,正如我们的建议所预测的那样.

blocks.en: 4.1 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4.1 方法

blocks.en:
We generated ten ad hoc focus markers. Each consisted of a randomly generated sequence of three to five characters sampled with replacement from the set { \{ “@”, “#”, “$”, “%”, “;”, “:” } \} . This sequence was placed immediately before the focused constituent, with the reversed version of the sequence being placed immediately after. This is illustrated by the minimal pair in ( 4.1 ): {exe} \ex {xlist} \ex Lucy only $:#swam#:$ yesterday. \ex Lucy only swam $:#yesterday#:$.


The total dataset therefore consisted of 10 × \times 282 = = 2,820 minimal pairs. Other than the change in focus marking, the experiment was run identically to Experiment 1.
blocks.zh:
我们产生了十个特设重点标记。 每一组由随机生成的三至五个字符序列组成,由套号{}“@”、“#”、“$”、“%”、“”、“”}所抽取的替换。 这个序列紧接在焦成份之前,而倒置版本的序列紧接其后. 缩写为最小对 (4.1) : {exe}\ex {xlist}\ex 露西只有美元:#游 #:$昨天。 ưμ㼯A 露西只游了1美元:#yesterday#:$.


因此,总数据集由10x\times 282==2,820对最小对组成. 除了重点标识的变化外,实验运行与实验1相同.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: Figure 3: Target results of Experiment 2 ( ad hoc focus-markers). Error bars are bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals. X-axes are logarithmically spaced.
blocks.zh: 图3 实验2(特设重点标记)的目标结果。 误差栏为95%的置信间隔 。 X轴为对数间距.

blocks.en: The target item results for Experiment 2 can be seen in Figure 3 . The control results, which we do not show for reasons of space, look similar to the control results from Experiment 1, but with lower peak accuracy. These continue to be outpaced by the target results, which again suggests that the backgrounds and prefixes play a crucial role. Put succinctly, the LMs are not just relying on a simple syntactic heuristic.
blocks.zh: 实验2的目标项目结果见图3。 由于空间原因,我们没有显示的控制结果与实验1的控制结果相似,但峰值准确度较低. 目标结果继续超过这些目标,这再次表明背景和前缀发挥着至关重要的作用。 简言之,LMS不仅仅是依赖简单的综合heuristic.

blocks.en: Turning to the target items, to compare methods we again fitted a mixed-effect logistic regression for each LM, predicting accuracy with a fixed effect of method (baseline = SP) and random effects of focus marker and item, using lme4 . SP continued to perform significantly above chance for every tested model (all p < .001 p<.001 ). This strongly suggests that what these models have learned about focus has a certain degree of generality, extending beyond canonical focus markers. The broad trend for FC also carried over from Experiment 1 to 2, with weak performance in smaller models that gradually improved to well beyond chance for larger, more capable models. The results for YN, which were the weakest in Experiment 1, more or less hovered around chance in Experiment 2.
blocks.zh: 关于目标项目,为了比较方法,我们再次为每个LM安装了混合效应后勤回归,用lme4来预测方法的固定效果(基线=SP)和焦点标记和项目的随机效果。 每个试验型号的SP的性能仍然大大高于机会(所有试验型号均为p < 001 p < 001)。 这强烈地表明,这些模型所学到的关于焦点的知识具有一定的概括性,超越了犬目焦点标记. FC的大趋势也从实验1延续到实验2,在较小的模型中性能弱小,逐渐改进到远远超出更大,能力更强的模型的机会. YN在实验1中是最弱的,在实验2中大致徘徊在机会上.

blocks.en: Importantly, the results from Experiment 2 do show the behavior predicted in Section 3 : FC performance degraded less than SP performance when moving from canonical to randomly generated focus markers. The change in percentage-point accuracy from Experiment 1 to Experiment 2 for each model and method can be seen in Figure 4 ; note that for nearly every model, both FC1 and FC2 had a less negative change than SP did.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,实验2的结果确实显示了第3节中预测的行为:FC性能在从犬科转向随机生成的焦点标记时退化得低于SP性能. 每种模型和方法从实验1到实验2的百分点精度变化在图4中可见一斑;注意到对于几乎所有模型来说,FC1和FC2的负变化都比SP小.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Percentage-point change in accuracy from Experiment 1 to Experiment 2 by model and method.
blocks.zh: 图 4:按模型和方法从实验1到实验2的精度百分比变化.

blocks.en: This observation holds even when accounting for the fact that SP had “farther to fall”, in the sense that SP often outperformed FC in Experiment 1. For example, when looking at the five pairs of model and prompting method that outperformed SP in Experiment 1, in four out of five cases FC still showed a smaller decrease in accuracy than SP did. Moreover, there are many more instances of FC significantly outperforming SP in Experiment 2 (twelve) than in Experiment 1 (five). Neither of these observations is to be expected if the sole reason for the greater decline in accuracy for SP was its greater accuracy in Experiment 1.
blocks.zh: 即使考虑到SP“远陷”的事实,这种观察仍维持不变,因为SP在实验1中的表现往往超过FC。 例如,在研究实验1中表现优于SP的五对模型和提示方法时,在五分之四的案例中,FC的精度仍比SP的精度下降较小. 此外,在实验2(十二)中,FC明显超过SP的情况比在实验1(五)中多得多。 如果SP的精度下降的唯一原因是其在实验1中的精度提高,那么这些观察都无法预料。

blocks.en: As a statistical test, for each experiment we took the mean accuracy across all focus markers for each combination of model, method, and item. We then fitted a mixed-effect linear regression model predicting ad hoc focus marker accuracy, with fixed effects of standard focus marker accuracy and evaluation method (baseline = SP) and random effects for item and LM, using the lmerTest R package ( Kuznetsova et al. 2017 ). Since one of the fixed effects is standard focus marker accuracy, this test controls for the fact that some model-method combinations had farther to fall than others. There was a significant positive effect of standard focus marker accuracy ( p < .001 p<.001 ), as well as positive effects for both FC1 and FC2 compared to the baseline of SP (both p < .001 p<.001 ), meaning that going from standard to ad hoc focus markers had a less negative impact on FC than on SP. Finally, there was a significant negative effect for both YN1 and YN2 ( p < .001 p<.001 for both), though this is difficult to interpret due to the general poor performance of YN and the possibility that poor results could be attributed to faulty prompting.
blocks.zh: 作为统计测试,对每一个实验, 我们用所有焦点标记的平均精度 来计算模型、方法和物品的组合。 然后,我们安装了一个混合效应线性回归模型,预测特设焦点标记的准确性,其定效为标准焦点标记的准确性和评价方法(基线=SP),以及项目和LM的随机效应,使用lmerTest R包(Kuznetsova等人,2017年)。 由于固定效果之一是标准焦距标记精度,因此这种测试控制了某些模型-方法组合比其他组合更远的下降. 标准焦点标记精确度(p < 001 p < 001)产生了显著的积极影响,与SP的基线(p < 001 p < 001)相比,FC1和FC2都产生了积极影响,这意味着从标准到特设焦点标记对FC的负面影响比对SP的消极影响要小. 最后,对YN1和YN2都产生了重大的负面影响(两者都存在 < 001 p < 001),尽管由于YN的绩效普遍不佳,结果不佳可能归因于提示错误,因此很难解释。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Our findings support the proposal put forward above. SP outperforming prompting methods in smaller models ( Hu and Levy 2023 ; Hu et al. 2024 ; Kauf et al. 2024 ), with prompting performance improving for larger models ( Hu and Frank 2024 ), is predicted if metalinguistic judgments constitute a non-trivial auxiliary task. Meanwhile, FC can outperform SP in larger models—including by a wide margin for Gemma 4—at least in part because FC, once learned, is more robust in its evaluation of sentences that are stylistically unlikely outputs. Hence, when switching from standard to randomly generated focus markers, FC saw a smaller decrease in accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果支持上述提议。 SP在较小的模型(Hu和Levy 2023;Hu等人 2024;Kauf等人 2024)中表现优异的促进方法,对较大模型(Hu和Frank 2024)的促进性能提高,如果金属学判断构成非三角辅助任务,则预测. 同时,FC在更大的模型中——包括Gemma 4的宽度——能够超过SP,至少部分原因是FC在获得知识后,在评价那些在形式上不可能产出的句子时更加有力。 因此,在从标准转向随机生成的焦点标记时,FC的精度下降幅度较小.

blocks.en: The strength of the conclusions we can draw from these results is somewhat limited by our focus on a singular empirical domain. A natural way to test the generality of these results would be to evaluate using other kinds of linguistic data that models might be similarly disinclined to generate, such as syntactically well-formed but semantically nonsensical sentences (cf. Gulordava et al. 2018 ); non-standard or -prestige dialects; socially unacceptable language use; and statements that are unambiguously false. Even beyond the particular hypotheses put forth in this paper, our results show that methodological comparisons can benefit from the investigation of linguistic phenomena beyond those covered by standard benchmarks like BLiMP ( Warstadt et al. 2020 ).
blocks.zh: 我们能够从这些结果中得出结论的力度,由于我们注重一个单一的经验领域而有些有限。 测试这些结果的通用性的自然方法是,利用其他种类的语言数据进行评估,这些模型可能同样地无法生成,例如,从战术上讲,构思良好,但并非敏锐的句子(参见Gulordava等人,2018年);非标准或偏好方言;社会上不能接受的语言使用;以及毫不含糊的虚假陈述。 我们的结果表明,对语言现象的调查可以超越BLIMP(Warstadt等人,2020年)等标准基准的范围。

blocks.en: Another promising path for future research would be to evaluate LMs’ linguistic competence using prompting-based methods that are not expressly metalinguistic in nature. Tasks like code generation, for example, are likely better represented in LMs’ training than metalinguistic judgments, so it is possible that the former will outperform the latter, particularly for smaller models. Not only might this lead to cleaner results, but it can also help to clarify which pros and cons of metalinguistic prompting are due specifically to the metalinguistic nature of the task.
blocks.zh: 今后研究的另一条有希望的道路是,使用并非明确具有金属性质的即兴方法来评价LMs的语言能力。 例如,像代码生成这样的任务在LMs的培训中可能比金属学的判断更有代表性,因此前者可能比后者强,特别是对于较小的模型。 这不仅可能导致更清洁的结果,而且有助于澄清哪些利弊的金属化诱导具体是由于任务的金属化性质。

blocks.en: Finally, it bears noting that the relative merits of prompting and string probabilities depend on more than just accuracy: they also depend on what these methods actually test, as it is not obvious that they test the same fundamental language abilities for a given model. A growing body of research is dedicated to discerning whether LMs are capable of introspection , defined as a model’s ability to predict or detect its own outputs via prompting. On the one hand, positive evidence exists suggesting that some models can non-trivially recognize their own outputs ( Panickssery et al. 2024 ), describe implicit behavioral patterns acquired via finetuning ( Betley et al. 2025 ), and learn with disproportionate success to predict their own hypothetical outputs ( Binder et al. 2025 ). On the other hand, Song et al. (2025) , who specifically test for introspection in metalinguistic judgments, fail to find it, though it is worth emphasizing that they base their conclusions of non-introspection on null results.
blocks.zh: 最后,值得注意的是,催化和弦概率的相对优点取决于的不仅仅是准确性:它们还取决于这些方法实际测试的是什么,因为并不明显,它们测试特定模型相同的基本语言能力. 越来越多的研究致力于辨别LMS是否有能力进行反省,被定义为模型通过提示预测或检测自身产出的能力. 一方面,有积极证据表明,有些模型可以非三进制地识别自己的输出(Paniksery等人,2024年),描述通过微调获得的隐含行为模式(Betley等人,2025年),并以不相称的成功学习来预测自己的假设输出(Binder等人,2025年). 另一方面,宋等人(2025年)在金属学判断中专门考证内观,却未能找到,虽然值得强调的是,他们将非内观的结论基于无效结果.

blocks.en: But suppose that Song et al. (2025) are right and LMs do not introspect when performing metalinguistic judgments, even when they judge with high accuracy. That is, the language knowledge LMs use to form judgments is distinct from the knowledge they use to generate tokens. One possible interpretation of such a result is that the explicit knowledge used by LMs to make judgments is essentially factual in nature, akin to knowing a bread recipe or a chess opening, whereas the implicit knowledge assessed via string probabilities is a more meaningful indicator of an LM’s linguistic competence. If this is true, then the accuracy of prompting is irrelevant, since it is simply not testing the relevant kind of language ability.
blocks.zh: 但假设Song et al. (2025)是正确的,LMs在进行金属学判断时不透视,即使他们以高精度判断. 也就是说,用于形成判断的LMs语言知识不同于它们用来生成符号的知识. 对这种结果的一种可能的解释是,LMs用于作出判断的明确知识本质上是事实性的,类似于知道面包食谱或棋盘开局,而通过弦概率评估的隐含知识则是LM语言能力的更有意义的指标。 如果这是真的,那么提示的准确性是无关紧要的,因为它根本不是测试相关的语言能力.

blocks.en: But there is an alternate interpretation that does not relegate prompting methods to such second-class status. The core language modeling task could be (somewhat simplistically) broken down into the subtasks of ( i ) interpreting the model’s input and ( ii ) generating a corresponding output. Importantly, there is no inherent reason to believe that the knowledge an LM uses to interpret a sentence S S as an input is identical to the knowledge it uses to produce S S as an output ( West et al. 2024 ).
blocks.zh: 但是,有另一种解释并不把促使方法置于这种二等地位。 核心语言建模任务可以是(有些简单)细分为(一)解释模型输入和(二)产生相应输出的子任务. 重要的是,没有内在的理由相信LM用来解释句子S S作为输入的知识与其用来生产S S作为输出的知识是相同的(West等人,2024年).

blocks.en: From this perspective, there are really two ways in which metalinguistic prompting and string probabilities differ from each other: explicit vs. implicit and input vs. output. Explicit judgments are still difficult, hence the poor performance in smaller models. But for models that can overcome that, the judgments they provide are informed by a facet of their language knowledge that is distinct from what is used for generation—hence, not introspective in the technical sense—but no less important in terms of the fundamental language modeling task. Or, indulging in some anthropomorphizing terminology, prompting tests comprehension, while probabilities test production. If this is the case, then prompting and probabilities are not so much competitors as they are complements, and both are needed for a complete understanding of LMs’ language competence.
blocks.zh: 从这个角度看,金属inguistic的诱导和字符串概率确实有两种不同的方式:显性与隐性,输入与输出. 明确的判断仍然很困难,因此在较小的模型中表现不佳。 但对于能够克服这种情况的模型来说,它们所提供的判断是以它们的语言知识的一面为参考的,这种知识不同于用于一代人的语言知识——从技术意义上讲,不是内在的,而是从基本的语文建模任务来看,同样重要。 或者,沉浸在一些人类化的术语中,激发测试的理解,同时概率测试生产. 如果是这样的话,那么,诱导和概率与其说是互补的竞争者,不如说是互补的竞争者,两者都是完全了解LMs语言能力所必需的。

blocks.en: All this being said, it remains to be seen whether introspection is in fact involved in LMs’ metalinguistic judgments, and if so, where and to what extent. But it is important to bear in mind as work on introspection progresses that the potential value of prompting-based linguistic assessment does not hinge entirely on whether LMs’ judgments are introspective in the particular sense defined above.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,还有待观察的是,反省是否实际上涉及金属金属学的判断,如果涉及,在何地和在什么程度上。 但必须铭记,随着反思工作的进展,促进基于语言的评估的潜在价值并不完全取决于LMs的判断是否属于上述特定意义上的反思。
